answer.reason: Only two passages describe events in the land itself, Abraham sending his sons there and Jacob coming there; the other marked verses speak of the east as a direction or of its peoples.

clauses.english: was where Abraham sent the sons of his concubines, with gifts
clauses.quote: sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country

clauses.english: was reached by Jacob on his journey
clauses.quote: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

doubts: Left out verses (JDG 6:3, 6:33, 7:12, 8:10, 1KI 4:30, JOB 1:3, JER 49:28, EZK 25:4, 25:10) that name the children or men of the east as a people, not the land.
Left out ISA 2:6, ISA 11:14, MAT 2:1-9 and REV 16:12, where "the east" is only a direction and may not be this land.
NUM 23:7 is already in the summary.
